title: Wardrobe — one Math Engine, carcass, doors, shelves and rail
description:
A parametric WARDROBE on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A NODE, A SEGMENT OR A SPACE. On a wall segment it takes the wall's direction and the doors face into the room; Flip side turns it round.

THE CARCASS IS FIVE PANELS, NOT A BLOCK — two sides, a top, a bottom and a back, each its own quad. That is why the internal volume metric means something and why the shelves have somewhere to land: a solid slab would report the same outline and describe nothing.

SLIDING DOORS ARE THE SAME LINE AS HINGED ONES. A sliding leaf must be wide enough to LAP its neighbour, and it must sit in a different plane from it. Both fall out of two expressions: `_lap` doubles the leaf width, and `(_di % 2) * _dT` steps the odd leaves forward by one door thickness. The alternating plane comes from the door INDEX, so it is right at any leaf count without a special case.

THE DOOR, SHELF AND HANDLE RUNS ARE ALL ONE BROADCAST. `arange(n)` gives every leaf's near edge, every shelf's height and every handle's position at once. Shelves divide the clear internal height into n+1 equal bays, which is what makes a shelf count read as spacing rather than as a stack.

HANDLES FOLLOW THE DOORS, not the carcass: `_hu = _db - 0.05` is the leading edge of whichever leaf it belongs to, so changing the door count moves every handle with it.

THE PLAN IS DERIVED from the same quads with z dropped. Shelves and the rail draw in plan because that is what a wardrobe's plan is asked to show; each is its own 2D row, since a grouped outline list is read EVEN-ODD and a shelf inside the carcass would otherwise void it.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS: 1.20 × 0.60 × 2.10 m, two 0.596 m hinged leaves, three shelves, a 1.164 m rail, 1.34 m³ internal.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. Doors are flat plates in the closed position — there is no swing, no hinge side and no open state. Internal divisions are full-width shelves only: no drawer bank, no vertical partition.

props.name: Material
props.value: light oak veneer, matte lacquer, bronze-tinted mirror panel

props.name: Semantics
props.value: modern wardrobe, matte white doors, brushed steel handles, minimal

params.name: Wardrobe maths
params.expr:
_natL = width
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_Wd = width * _s
_Dp = depth * _s
_Ht = height * _s
_t = panelThk * _s
_pl = plinthHeight * _s
_gap = doorGap * _s
_u0 = 0 - _Wd / 2
_u1 = _Wd / 2
_v0 = 0 - _Dp / 2
_v1 = _Dp / 2
_cz0 = _pl
_cz1 = _Ht
_bodyL = _Wd
_bodyW = _Dp
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
# Carcass — two sides, top, bottom and back, so the box is HOLLOW, not a solid slab
_S1 = hcat(_u0, _v0, _u0 + _t, _v0, _u0 + _t, _v1, _u0, _v1, _cz0, _cz1, 1)
_S2 = hcat(_u1 - _t, _v0, _u1, _v0, _u1, _v1, _u1 - _t, _v1, _cz0, _cz1, 1)
_TP = hcat(_u0 + _t, _v0, _u1 - _t, _v0, _u1 - _t, _v1, _u0 + _t, _v1, _cz1 - _t, _cz1, 1)
_BT = hcat(_u0 + _t, _v0, _u1 - _t, _v0, _u1 - _t, _v1, _u0 + _t, _v1, _cz0, _cz0 + _t, 1)
_BK = hcat(_u0 + _t, _v1 - _t, _u1 - _t, _v1 - _t, _u1 - _t, _v1, _u0 + _t, _v1, _cz0 + _t, _cz1 - _t, 1)
_PLr = hcat(_u0, _v0 + 0.02 * _s, _u1, _v0 + 0.02 * _s, _u1, _v1, _u0, _v1, 0, _pl, 3)
_PL0 = _pl > 0.001 ? _PLr : zeros(0, 11)
# Internal shelves — one broadcast up the clear internal height
_nsh = max(0, round(shelves))
_iz0 = _cz0 + _t
_iz1 = _cz1 - _t
_shz = _iz0 + (arange(_nsh) + 1) * (_iz1 - _iz0) / (_nsh + 1)
_SH = hcat(fill(_nsh,1,_u0 + _t), fill(_nsh,1,_v0 + _t), fill(_nsh,1,_u1 - _t), fill(_nsh,1,_v0 + _t), fill(_nsh,1,_u1 - _t), fill(_nsh,1,_v1 - _t), fill(_nsh,1,_u0 + _t), fill(_nsh,1,_v1 - _t), _shz, _shz + _t, fill(_nsh,1,5))
# Hanging rail — a flat bar, so it reads in plan as well as in section
_rz = _iz1 - railDrop * _s
_rr = 0.016 * _s
_RLr = hcat(_u0 + _t, 0 - _rr, _u1 - _t, 0 - _rr, _u1 - _t, _rr, _u0 + _t, _rr, _rz - _rr, _rz + _rr, 6)
_RL = hangingRail > 0 ? _RLr : zeros(0, 11)
# Doors — divided across the full width; Sliding doubles the leaf and laps it in two planes
_ndr = max(0, round(doors))
_isSlide = doorStyle == 'Sliding'
_dT = 0.018 * _s
_lap = _isSlide ? 2 : 1
_dpitch = _Wd / max(1, _ndr)
_dw = _dpitch * _lap - _gap
_di = arange(_ndr)
_da = _u0 + _di * _dpitch + _gap / 2
_db = min(_da + _dw, _u1)
_dv0 = _isSlide ? (_v0 - _dT + (_di % 2) * _dT) : fill(_ndr, 1, _v0 - _dT)
_dv1 = _dv0 + _dT
_DR = hcat(_da, _dv0, _db, _dv0, _db, _dv1, _da, _dv1, fill(_ndr,1,_cz0), fill(_ndr,1,_cz1), fill(_ndr,1,2))
# Handles — a vertical bar on the leading edge of every leaf
_hw = 0.02 * _s
_hz = (_cz0 + _cz1) / 2
_hl = min(0.16 * _s, (_cz1 - _cz0) / 3)
_hu = _db - 0.05 * _s
_HDr = hcat(_hu, _dv0 - _hw, _hu + _hw, _dv0 - _hw, _hu + _hw, _dv0, _hu, _dv0, fill(_ndr,1,_hz - _hl), fill(_ndr,1,_hz + _hl), fill(_ndr,1,4))
_HD = (handles > 0 && _ndr > 0) ? _HDr : zeros(0, 11)
# Mirror and grooves are applied to the DOOR TABLE THAT ALREADY EXISTS — the same _da / _db /
# _dv0 the leaves were built from — so a leaf that moves takes its mirror and its grooves with it.
_mSel = mirrorPanel == 'All panels' ? ones(_ndr, 1) : (mirrorPanel == 'First panel' ? eq(_di, 0) : (mirrorPanel == 'Last panel' ? eq(_di, _ndr - 1) : fill(_ndr, 1, 0)))
_mIn = 0.05 * _s
_mT = 0.004 * _s
_MRt = hcat(_da + _mIn, _dv0 - _mT, _db - _mIn, _dv0 - _mT, _db - _mIn, _dv0, _da + _mIn, _dv0, fill(_ndr,1,_cz0 + _mIn), fill(_ndr,1,_cz1 - _mIn), fill(_ndr,1,7))
_MIR = _ndr > 0 ? compress(_MRt, _mSel) : zeros(0, 11)
# Grooves — leaves crossed with grooves-per-leaf in one kron pair, so one groove or twelve is
# the same four lines. 'Handle only' is the same recess reduced to one per leading edge.
_gV = grooveStyle == 'Vertical'
_gH = grooveStyle == 'Horizontal'
_gP = grooveStyle == 'Handle only'
_gwT = grooveWidth * _s
_gdT = 0.006 * _s
_ng = max(1, round(grooveCount))
_gn = _ndr * _ng
_gj = kron(ones(_ndr, 1), arange(_ng))
_gda = kron(_da, ones(_ng, 1))
_gdb = kron(_db, ones(_ng, 1))
_gdv = kron(_dv0, ones(_ng, 1))
_gpx = (_gdb - _gda) / (_ng + 1)
_gu0 = _gda + (_gj + 1) * _gpx - _gwT / 2
_gVt = hcat(_gu0, _gdv - _gdT, _gu0 + _gwT, _gdv - _gdT, _gu0 + _gwT, _gdv, _gu0, _gdv, fill(_gn,1,_cz0), fill(_gn,1,_cz1), fill(_gn,1,8))
_gpz = (_cz1 - _cz0) / (_ng + 1)
_gz0 = _cz0 + (_gj + 1) * _gpz - _gwT / 2
_gHt = hcat(_gda, _gdv - _gdT, _gdb, _gdv - _gdT, _gdb, _gdv, _gda, _gdv, _gz0, _gz0 + _gwT, fill(_gn,1,8))
_gPt = hcat(_db - _gwT - 0.01 * _s, _dv0 - _gdT, _db - 0.01 * _s, _dv0 - _gdT, _db - 0.01 * _s, _dv0, _db - _gwT - 0.01 * _s, _dv0, fill(_ndr,1,_cz0 + _mIn), fill(_ndr,1,_cz1 - _mIn), fill(_ndr,1,8))
_GRV = _ndr < 1 ? zeros(0, 11) : (_gV ? _gVt : (_gH ? _gHt : (_gP ? _gPt : zeros(0, 11))))
# Top filler carries the carcass up to a ceiling line so there is no dust shelf above it.
_fz = max(_cz1, fillerTo)
_FILr = hcat(_u0, _v0, _u1, _v0, _u1, _v1, _u0, _v1, _cz1, _fz, 9)
_FIL = (topFiller > 0 && _fz > _cz1 + 0.002) ? _FILr : zeros(0, 11)
_epTop = topFiller > 0 ? _fz : _cz1
_epL = endPanel == 'Left' || endPanel == 'Both'
_epR = endPanel == 'Right' || endPanel == 'Both'
_epT = _t * 1.6
_EP1 = hcat(_u0 - _epT, _v0 - 0.02 * _s, _u0, _v0 - 0.02 * _s, _u0, _v1, _u0 - _epT, _v1, 0, _epTop, 10)
_EP2 = hcat(_u1, _v0 - 0.02 * _s, _u1 + _epT, _v0 - 0.02 * _s, _u1 + _epT, _v1, _u1, _v1, 0, _epTop, 10)
_EPN = vcat(_epL ? _EP1 : zeros(0, 11), _epR ? _EP2 : zeros(0, 11))
Q = vcat(_S1, _S2, _TP, _BT, _BK, _PL0, _SH, _RL, _DR, _HD, _MIR, _GRV, _FIL, _EPN)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Carcass3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Doors3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Plinth3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 3)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Handles3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 4)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Shelves3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 5)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Rail3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 6)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
CarcassPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
DoorsPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 2)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
ShelvesPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 5)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
RailPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 6)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
Mirror3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 7)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Grooves3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 8)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Filler3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 9)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
EndPanels3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 10)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
MirrorPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 7)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
EndPanelsPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 10)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Metrics
overallWidth = _Wd
overallDepth = _Dp
overallHeight = _Ht
doorLeaves = _ndr
doorWidth = _ndr > 0 ? _dw : 0
shelfRun = _nsh * (_Wd - 2 * _t)
railLength = hangingRail > 0 ? (_Wd - 2 * _t) : 0
internalVolume = (_Wd - 2 * _t) * (_Dp - _t) * (_iz1 - _iz0)
footprint = _Wd * _Dp
mirrorLeaves = mirrorPanel == 'None' ? 0 : (mirrorPanel == 'All panels' ? _ndr : min(1, _ndr))
mirrorArea = mirrorLeaves * max(0, _dw - 2 * _mIn) * max(0, _cz1 - _cz0 - 2 * _mIn)
grooveRun = grooveStyle == 'None' ? 0 : (_gV ? (_gn * (_cz1 - _cz0)) : (_gH ? (_gn * _dw) : (_ndr * (_cz1 - _cz0 - 2 * _mIn))))
fillerHeight = (topFiller > 0) ? max(0, _fz - _cz1) : 0
totalHeight = (topFiller > 0) ? _fz : _Ht
endPanelCount = _epL + _epR
